traditional: 搞到 A 冇晒 B
jyutping: gaau2 dou3 A mou5 saai3 B

english.note: Use this everyday construction when a situation leaves someone without a resource such as energy or time.

examples.english: This assignment is enough to rob me of all my time.
examples.traditional: 呢份功課搞到我冇晒時間。
examples.jyutping: ni1 fan6 gung1 fo3 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 mou5 saai3 si4 gaan3
